ValidationRule.description: If Campaign is Marketing Campaign RT, and Campaign Level is Parent or Child, then Parent Campaign field must be populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Campaign_Level__c, "Child: Delivery Mechanism Type"), ISPICKVAL( Campaign_Level__c, "Parent: Program") ), ISBLANK( ParentId ), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Marketing_Record_Type')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Parent Campaign is required when Campaign Level is Parent or Child
